# Skill: commit

Use this skill when creating commits in this repository.

## Required workflow

1. Commit in small, logical chunks. Do not bundle unrelated changes into one commit.
2. Keep commit subjects short, all lower case, and at most 6 words.
3. Do not use conventional commit prefixes in commit subjects (for example `fix:`, `feat:`, `chore:`).
4. If more context is needed, use the commit description/body to summarize the changes.
5. Use commit-type prefixes for branch names and worktree names instead (for example `feat/...`, `fix/...`, `chore/...` and matching worktree names such as `feat-...`, `fix-...`, `chore-...`).
